title: wt workspace config
description: Declarative configuration for the universal wt orchestrator (see core/src/config.ts WorkspaceConfig).

title.description: Human-facing workspace title shown in the TUI/web frontends.

serverProject.description: Project name used as the --server link shorthand target.

projectsDir.description: Multi-repo: subdir holding the repos (default 'projects'). Mutually exclusive with 'project'.

project.description: Single-repo: the one project (repo root). Mutually exclusive with 'projects'.

projects.description: Multi-repo: map of project directory name -> project config.

prefix.description: Worktree branch prefix and slug<->branch rule (e.g. feature/).

mounts.description: Extra -v entries appended after the plugin's mounts: /abs/host:/container[:ro], ./relative-to-workspace:/container or volume:/container.

plugin.description: Plugin package name; falls back to defaults.plugin.

docker.description: Present => dockerized; image is the sole source.

core.description: Present => part of the core stack (wt up/down).
